method.corpus: Actual Solidity-rendered frame 0; fixed block number/timestamp/gas limit/base fee/beneficiary/chain ID; prevrandao 1..N; no phase/reversal/mirror/crop/pan credit
method.comparison: Exactly undo mirror/crop/pan, then mask to source y=32..111; exact RGB and palette-index hashes; global exact L2 radius search on a 60D averaging projection followed by a full 480D distance filter, covering every pair that can pass the RGB-RMSE threshold, with 2/255 rounding margin; HNSW adds closest-pair previews and diagnostic structure neighbours; refine at 32x20 RGB RMSE and Gaussian luminance SSIM
method.near_threshold: RGB RMSE <=0.035 AND luminance SSIM >=0.98; at most 0.1% tokens in flagged pairs
method.limits: The RGB near-duplicate gate covers all pairs under this downsampled metric; structural diagnostic neighbours use approximate HNSW. Neither is a guarantee of subjective uniqueness or of future mints. Full 90-frame movies are separately validated on selected samples.
